hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "pnpm build" && echo "$TOOL_OUTPUT" | grep -q "built in"; then echo "[post-build-qa] Build succeeded. Run quality gate: pnpm vitest run && pnpm tsc --noEmit && ./scripts/verify-tokens.sh"; fi'
hooks.description: Remind to run quality gate after successful builds during the pipeline
Lint staged content against brand-guidelines.json before git commits
After a clean brand-voice lint, remind about the remaining editorial QA gates
Warn when a command looks like an external publish/send/spend without a recorded approval
